WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) AS order_date,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2018-05-28' AND CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) < DATE '2018-06-04' THEN 'window'
      WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2018-05-21' AND CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) < DATE '2018-05-28' THEN 'baseline'
    END AS period,
    CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_late
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2018-05-28' AND CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) < DATE '2018-06-04')
      OR (CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2018-05-21' AND CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) < DATE '2018-05-28')
    )
)
SELECT
  period,
  order_date,
  COUNT(*) AS completed,
  SUM(is_late) AS late,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(is_late) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 4) AS late_share
FROM filtered
WHERE period IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY period, order_date
ORDER BY period, order_date;
